proved_in_scope: For universal fixed constant C, exact residual nonconstancy of a macro with verified explicit cover size <= C is discoverable deterministically in polynomial time in actual encoded N, assuming explicit state serialization is polynomial in N.
All one-step NOT/AND candidates over explicit V are polynomially enumerable in V.
An explicit inherited cover certificate avoids any need to solve minimum set cover.

hidden_exponent.name: NEIGHBORHOOD_COVER_COUNT
hidden_exponent.warning: If c(e)=c(N) grows with input, this is not a polynomial-time bound with a universal fixed exponent.
